g.text: Durable services restart. Connection state does not: socket actors and topic workers are Temporary, so clients reconnect or rejoin.
Raw beryl.child_spec uses the same main tree.
It has no topic worker supervisor; init and update run in the socket actor.
Current sockets close; clients reconnect and rejoin.
Owned sockets stop; the router sweeps state and closes transports.
The WebSocket closes; the client reconnects.
Only that topic closes; the client rejoins it.
beryl.stop drains sockets, then the significant router exits normally.
The internal subtree auto-shuts down; the parent does not restart it.
1. Child specifications in the application tree
Nested beryl internal supervisor — OneForOne, 3 restarts / 5 s, AnySignificant
Dashed arrows = monitors; solid arrows = ownership or message flow
